exclusion_reason: Modding is implemented as a copy-on-write overlay: a mod is layered into an overlay directory over a read-only base whose package identity is verified unchanged after the apply, every mod path is contained (a parent-path escape is refused), and the total overlay is refused above the declared bound. The benchmark stays red because running the modded title needs the absent browser game runtime.
promotion_trigger: Promote when the mod overlay applies with unchanged base hash inside containment and the oversized case is refused.
expected_failing_assertion: No overlay exists to layer a mod on.
active_gate_evidence: test/library.test.mjs asserts the base identity is unchanged, override and addition overlay files stage, and an oversized mod is refused at the bound.
procedure: Apply the mod fixture and compare the base hash.
Assert mod file access stays inside containment.
Apply an oversized mod and assert refusal at the bound.
pass_criterion: Containment holds and the bound refuses.
